name: Sorcery Points
description: Sorcery points pay for Flexible Casting and your Metamagic options. You can never hold more than the maximum for your level.
A long rest refills them all.

name: Font of Magic
description: Bonus action: swap between spell slots and sorcery points.
Make a slot: spend points to create one slot of 5th level or lower. Cost: 1st level 2 points, 2nd level 3, 3rd level 5, 4th level 6, 5th level 7.
Burn a slot: expend one slot and gain sorcery points equal to its level.

name: Sorcerous Restoration
description: When you finish a short rest, you regain 4 expended sorcery points.

name: Elemental Affinity
trigger: You cast a spell of your ancestry damage type
description: Your spells that deal your dragon ancestor's damage type get your Charisma modifier added once to the damage.
Pay 1 sorcery point and you also resist that type for 1 hour.

name: Dragon Wings
description: Grow a pair of dragon wings. You fly at a speed equal to your walking speed. They remain until you dismiss them, which also costs a bonus action.
They won't come out in armor that isn't made for them, and unsuitable clothing may be ruined.

name: Draconic Presence
description: Pay 5 sorcery points to radiate awe or fear (you choose) out to 60 ft for 1 minute. It needs your concentration, just like a concentration spell.

Each hostile creature that begins its turn in the aura makes a Wisdom save. A failure means charmed (awe) or frightened (fear) until the aura ends. A success makes that creature immune to the aura for 24 hours.

name: Tides of Chaos
uses: Once, then long rest (or after a surge)
description: Give yourself advantage on a single d20 roll: an attack, a check or a save.

After that it stays spent until you finish a long rest. The exception: if the DM triggers a Wild Magic Surge once you cast a sorcerer spell (1st level or above), you roll the surge and the feature is ready again.

name: Bend Luck
trigger: A creature you can see makes an attack roll, ability check or saving throw
description: Another creature you can see is about to roll an attack, check or save. Spend 2 sorcery points and roll 1d4. You add that number to or subtract it from their roll, your choice.
Do this after their roll is made but before the result takes effect.

name: Spell Bombardment
trigger: You roll spell damage and a die shows its highest number
description: Once per turn, when you roll spell damage and any die shows its maximum number, pick one of those dice and roll it again, adding the new roll to the damage.

name: Careful Spell
trigger: You cast a spell that makes other creatures save
description: Shield some targets from your spell. Choose up to your Charisma modifier creatures (at least 1); they pass their save automatically.

name: Distant Spell
trigger: You cast a spell with a range of 5 feet or more, or touch
description: Doubles the range of a spell whose range is 5 feet or more. A touch spell instead gets a range of 30 feet.

name: Empowered Spell
trigger: You roll damage for a spell
description: Pick up to your Charisma modifier (at least 1) of the dice rolled for damage and roll them again. You must keep the new results.
It stacks with another Metamagic option used on the same casting.

name: Extended Spell
trigger: You cast a spell with a duration of 1 minute or longer
description: Doubles the duration of the spell, up to a maximum of 24 hours. Useful for buffs you want to last through a whole day.

name: Heightened Spell
trigger: You cast a spell that forces a saving throw
description: Pick one target of the spell. It rolls its first save against the spell with disadvantage.

name: Quickened Spell
trigger: You cast a spell with a casting time of 1 action
description: Turns the casting time of that spell from an action into a bonus action for this casting.

name: Subtle Spell
description: Cast the spell with no verbal or somatic components, so nobody hears or sees you doing it.

name: Twinned Spell
trigger: You cast a spell that targets only one creature and is not range self
resource: Sorcery points equal to the spell's level (1 for a cantrip)
description: Spend points equal to the spell's level (1 for a cantrip) to give a single-target spell a second target within range. The spell cannot have a range of self.
